heroHeadline: Great Green Wall Observatory Launched in Ouagadougou — First Public Accountability Dashboard for 11-Nation, $15B Sahel Restoration Initiative
heroSubtitle: Ministers and delegations from all 11 Great Green Wall nations met in Ouagadougou (May 27–29) to unveil the GGW Observatory — the first digital platform making financial and project data for 302+ GGW projects publicly accessible. On World Biodiversity Day (May 22), CBD marked the first major implementation cycle of the Kunming-Montreal Framework with calls to accelerate local action; verified restoration delivery globally remains far below the 1-billion-hectare UN Decade target. Only ~15% of the $19B pledged for the Great Green Wall has been disbursed, and independent analysis puts verified native ecological restoration at 4–8% of the 100 million ha goal — underscoring why the Observatory's transparency mandate matters.
footerNote: Data sourced from UNEP, FAO, UNCCD, IUCN, WRI Global Forest Watch, INPE, CBD, and Tier 2 science outlets. Pledge figures reflect commitments; verified restoration is substantially lower.
